title: Matching fibrations of a right resolution detect mapping equivalences
statement: Use the model-category and homotopy-function-complex conventions of [lem-coef-cosimplicial-frame-mapping], the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and the simplicial Reedy matching objects of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure]. Let $Z$ be a fibrant object of a model category $\mathcal M$. There exists a Reedy fibrant simplicial object $Z_\bullet:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal M$ and an objectwise weak-equivalence coaugmentation $\operatorname{const}Z\to Z_\bullet$, with $Z_0=Z$ and degree-zero coaugmentation the identity. Any such choice has the following properties. For every $n\geq0$, its matching map $p_n:Z_n\to M_nZ_\bullet$ is an original fibration; here $M_n$ is the limit over proper face restrictions in the Reedy matching category, and $M_0Z_\bullet=1$. For every cofibrant $T$, the simplicial set $R(T,Z_\bullet)_n=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal M}(T,Z_n)$ is Kan and represents $\operatorname{Map}^h(T,Z)$, naturally in $T$. For every cofibration $u:U\to V$ with cofibrant source, the map $R(V,Z_\bullet)\to R(U,Z_\bullet)$ is a Kan fibration, and the following conditions are equivalent: (i) $\operatorname{Map}^h(V,Z)\to\operatorname{Map}^h(U,Z)$ is an equivalence; (ii) $R(V,Z_\bullet)\to R(U,Z_\bullet)$ is a trivial Kan fibration; (iii) $u$ has the left lifting property against every $p_n$, $n\geq0$. A left lifting property means existence of a diagonal in every commutative square, as in [lem-coef-lifting-class-closure]. Kan fibrations, trivial Kan fibrations and the boundary test have the meanings of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. No properness, combinatoriality or simplicial enrichment is assumed.
